It contains self-contained agent templates across multiple frameworks (LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen, Google ADK, Langflow, A2A, and vanilla Python), shared reusable components (auth, postgresql), deployment guides, and a behavioral evaluation harness.
